messages:
Samir Khatri: Heads-up: running a DB migration rehearsal over the weekend. Were instituting a targeted partial release freeze to reduce blast radius. Effective now until Sun 20:00 UTC or until lifted early. Block: schema changes, storage routing changes, mass data backfills. Allow: security patches, hotpatches, read-only telemetry toggles.

Jen Park: Got it. Please clarify labeling and exemptions so teams know how to proceed. Also will update release-docs and product channels.

Alex Mora: Observability note  during a short canary earlier we saw search-indexer p95 climb ~18% and p99 spikes to ~520ms. Suspect GC + cold KV connections during warmup. I'm dedicating 1 extra n1-highmem pool and bumping node-provision buffer 2->4 for the freeze period.

deploy-bot: Policy: PRs with label `deploy:freeze-hold` will be blocked by CI until freeze is removed. Use label `deploy:urgent` + pager duty approval for emergency rollouts.

Lina Gomez: I'll ping integrators and partners with a brief status note and add a banner to the internal status page. Expect minor throughput variation during rehearsal.

Samir Khatri: Canary snapshot 13:12 UTC: embed proxy p50 31ms, p95 240ms (baseline 210ms), p99 520ms. Error rate nominal. Traces show a few 10s GC pauses on a couple pods.

Alex Mora: Quick log grab if you want to inspect:
```bash
kubectl -n canary logs -l app=search-indexer --since=20m | egrep "GC pause|p95|connection reset" -A3
```
Artifacts stored: s3://redwood-canary-logs/2026-03-23/search-indexer.log (retained 7d).

Jen Park: Rollback/abort rules (added to runbook): automatic rollback if error rate > 0.7% OR p95 > baseline +250ms for a sustained 5m window. Oncall must confirm before any manual continue.

Maya Rivera (oncall): I'll stand watch on the canary dashboards and mirror alerts to the release channel. If the rollback condition fires I'll page release leads and flip deployments to stop.

Samir Khatri: Proposed lift = Sun 20:00 UTC provided we have at least a continuous 48h stability window prior. If not, we'll do +24h extension syncs. Please ack with a quick reaction. :thumbsup:

Jen Park: +1  will coordinate cross-functional comms and add a short FAQ in release-docs.

Lina Gomez: +1 from partner comms.

Alex Mora: +1, attaching dashboard links to the release doc.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: posting automated status every 3h to this thread until freeze is lifted.

Samir Khatri: Thanks everyone. I'll draft a short exec note after the rehearsal completes or if we hit any rollback triggers.
